purpose: RPCI probability distribution + 90% prediction range + explanation rules

classification_conformal.method: split conformal using score 1 - p_true on the locked probability ensemble
notes: Coverage is marginal, not guaranteed conditionally for every individual race or every set-size subgroup.
Prediction sets were already contiguous in the holdout data, so they can be displayed as an ordinal RPCI band range.

continuous_conformal.model: ExtraTrees regression using only pre-race current-condition features plus entrants' prior-history aggregates
notes: Global split conformal was more stable than surface-specific or surface-by-distance Mondrian variants on 2025/2026.
Use the class conformal set as the primary user-facing range; continuous interval can be shown as technical detail.

certainty.2_bands: 方向性あり・二帯想定

wording_constraints: Never say the race structure is certain or guaranteed.
Do not call a one-band conformal set 90% certain; conformal coverage is marginal and subgroup coverage can differ.
Always show all four probabilities and the 90% conformal band range.
If two or more bands are included, describe the structure as a range rather than a point estimate.
Use lower RPCI as front-loaded/forward-leaning and higher RPCI as slower/late-leaning wording rather than absolute pace speed claims.

example.certainty_label: 方向性あり・二帯想定
example.summary: 前傾寄りが本線だが、平均帯までを含む二帯想定。極端なスローの確率は低い。
